title: Prebid-Config-Auditor Output
description: Machine-readable Prebid.js configuration audit result. Raw JSON only — no markdown fences, no surrounding text.

audit_status.description: Overall audit verdict. Pass: all checks within acceptable range. Needs_Optimization: one warning present. Critical_Issues: timeout violation + density violation simultaneously, OR priceGranularity == 'low'.

timeout_analysis.description: States the bidderTimeout value, its classification (too slow / too aggressive / acceptable), and the performance impact. Must reference the numeric value from the input.

bidder_density_warnings.description: One string per ad unit that violates density rules (>8 bidders = LATENCY_RISK, <2 bidders = UNDERFILLED). Empty array when all ad units are within 2–8 bidders.

granularity_check.description: States the priceGranularity value, its classification, and the revenue impact. Flags 'low' granularity explicitly.

bidderTimeout.description: Recommended bidderTimeout in ms. 1200 when current value is outside 500–2000ms; current value otherwise.

priceGranularity.description: Recommended priceGranularity value. 'dense' when current is 'low' or 'medium'; current value otherwise.

notes.description: One sentence explaining the highest-priority recommended change and its expected impact.

constraints.output_format: Raw JSON only. No markdown code fences. No surrounding text.
constraints.audit_status_logic: Critical_Issues requires (timeout_violation AND density_violation) OR priceGranularity=='low'. Needs_Optimization requires any single warning. Pass requires all checks clean.
constraints.timeout_analysis_must_include: The numeric bidderTimeout value from the input.
constraints.recommendation_timeout_range: bidderTimeout in recommendation must be between 500 and 2000 inclusive.
